children: Arabian Centres Company (Cenomi Centers) has awarded a contract for integrated facilities management (FM) services for Westfield Jeddah, a retail destination, to DAAM Facilities Management Company (DAAM IFM).
The estimated value of the three-year contract is 104.3 million Saudi riyals ($27.85 million), the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
The deal includes an annual fixed base value of SAR 28.64 million and specialist services charged at actual cost plus a 5 percent management fee, estimated at SAR 6.12 million annually.

The contract will cover the supply, delivery, management and procurement of integrated facilities management services at Westfield Jeddah, including specialist facilities management services and the implementation, coordination, reporting and monitoring of all related service activities.
The financial impact is expected to be reflected in the company's results over the contract term, commencing from the fourth quarter of 2026, the statement said.

title: Cenomi Centers awards $28mln FM services contract for Westfield Jeddah
